It is also suitable for Agentic workflows due to its tool calling capabilities. This model is ready for commercial usage. ## Model Description (Mistral Nemotron)
Mistral-Nemotron is a Mistral model optimized by NVIDIA for efficient deployment and agentic workflows. NVIDIA documents 128K context, tool calling, TensorRT-LLM/vLLM integration and H100 evaluation.
